product.title: Yellowstone Full Day Private Tour & Hike - from Inside the Park

description.text: Guests staying inside Yellowstone meet a private guide for a six- to eight-hour tour combining scenic drives and guided hikes. The route covers Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic Spring overlooks, and rim trails at the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone tailored to your group's fitness level.

highlights: Private tour and hike for guests staying inside the park
Old Faithful and Grand Prismatic Spring stops
Guided rim hike at Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone
Trail choice matched to group fitness

start.description: Meet your guide at your in-park lodge or campground near Old Faithful or Canyon Village. Confirm meeting point when booking.

end.description: Return to your in-park lodging after the guided hike and final geyser basin stop.

faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 to 8 hours.

faqs.answer: Meet your guide at your in-park lodge or campground near Old Faithful or Canyon Village. Confirm meeting point when booking.
